quiz-s49.condition: Unit 4 My Tidy World, с. 49. Викторина об уборке: где ты делаешь эти дела?
steps: I walk my dog outside. I cook dinner (or help mum) in the kitchen. I tidy my room in my bedroom. I wash the car in the yard. I water the plants in the garden. I do the washing up in the kitchen.
quiz-s49.answer: Ответы с местом: outside, in the kitchen, in my bedroom, in the yard, in the garden

1-s50.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19 Saturday Morning Chores, упр. 1, с. 50. Прослушай и соотнеси слова из рамки A с B.

2-s50.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 2, с. 50. По картинкам скажи, что делает каждый член семьи Глоу.
steps: Sam and Pam are tidying their room. Mandy is taking Bonehead for a walk. Bernard is washing his car. Martha is throwing out the rubbish. Vincent is going food shopping. Helga is doing the washing up. Rudolph is vacuuming. Cactus is eating a fish.
2-s50.answer: Present Progressive: are tidying, is taking for a walk, is washing, is throwing out, is going shopping, is doing the washing up

3-s50.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 3, с. 50. Прослушай ещё раз: верно (1) или неверно (2)?

4-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 4, с. 51. Опиши, что твоя семья делает сейчас по дому.
steps: At the moment I am cleaning my room. Mum is watering the flowers in the garden. Dad is going food shopping. My sister is doing the washing up. Our dog is sleeping on the rug.
4-s51.answer: 4–5 предложений в Present Progressive (am / is / are + -ing)

5-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 5, с. 51. a) Найди предметы на картинке (с. 50). b) Прослушай вопросы и ответь. c) В парах задайте вопросы What's … doing?
steps: a) Rudolph is wearing a raincoat. Martha has put on rubber gloves to throw out the rubbish. Bernard has got a bucket and a sponge.
b) His car. Tidying their room. A fish. For a walk. Food shopping.
c) What's Cactus eating? — A fish. What are Sam and Pam doing? — They're tidying their room. What's Bernard washing? — His car.
5-s51.answer: Ответы по картинке и диалог с вопросами в Present Progressive

6-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 6, с. 51. a) Составь анкету о домашних обязанностях. b) Опроси группу. c) Доложи классу.
steps: a) Список: look after my little brother, wash the dishes, walk the dog, tidy my room, water the plants, take out the rubbish.
b) Считаем: look after little brother — 2 persons; wash the dishes — 3; walk the dog — 1; tidy room — 4.
c) Two of us look after our little brothers and sisters. Three of us wash the dishes. All of us tidy our rooms.
6-s51.answer: Анкета + результаты: Two / Three / All of us + обязанность

7-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 7, с. 51. Дополни предложения глаголами в Present Progressive.
steps: is closing; is having; is brushing; is opening; are cleaning.
7-s51.answer: is closing, is having, is brushing, is opening, are cleaning

8-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 8, с. 51. Прослушай и соотнеси предложения с картинками.

9-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 9, с. 51. В парах задайте вопросы What is / are … doing? по картинкам упр. 8.
steps: What are they doing? — They're brushing their teeth. What is he doing? — He's opening the door. What are they doing? — They're cleaning the windows. What is she doing? — She's having breakfast.
9-s51.answer: What is / are … doing? — He's / She's / They're + -ing

10-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 10, с. 51. Дополни диалоги глаголами в скобках.
steps: A: What are you doing? B: I am tidying my room. A: Where is she going? B: She is going to school. A: What are they eating? B: They are eating sandwiches.
10-s51.answer: are you doing / am tidying; is she going / is going; are they eating / are eating

11-s51.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 19, упр. 11, с. 51. Составь вопросы и ответы о делах семьи Глоу.
steps: What is Bernard washing? — His car. What is Martha throwing out? — The rubbish. What's Vincent doing? — He's going food shopping. Who is Mandy walking? — Bonehead. What are Sam and Pam tidying? — Their room.
11-s51.answer: Специальные вопросы в Present Progressive и краткие ответы

1-s52.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20 Work and Play, упр. 1, с. 52. Прослушай и повтори; раздели занятия на работу и отдых.
steps: Work: tidy my room, do the washing up, go food shopping, lay the table, walk the dog, look after my sister.
Play: surf the internet, hang out with friends, play computer games, watch TV, go swimming.
1-s52.answer: Work — tidy, wash up, shop, lay the table, walk the dog; Play — internet, friends, games, TV, swimming

2-s52.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 2, с. 52. a) Прослушай анкету Йена. b) Заполни пропуски. c) Прослушай и проверь.
steps: a) — Как часто ты убираешь комнату? — Раз или два в неделю. — Как часто моешь посуду? — Три-четыре раза в месяц…
b) 1 once or twice a week; 2 three or four times a month; 3 never; 4 Sunday; 5 every Saturday morning; 6 weekend; 7 every day.
2-s52.answer: once or twice a week, three or four times a month, never, Sunday, every Saturday morning, weekend, every day

3-s52.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 3, с. 52. Расскажи о Йене: «Йен школьник. Он часто помогает по дому…»
steps: Ian is a schoolboy. He often helps about the house. He tidies his room once or twice a week. He also washes the dishes three or four times a month. He never goes food shopping. He lays the table on Sundays. He walks the dog every Saturday morning. At the weekend he hangs out with friends.
3-s52.answer: Рассказ в 3 л. ед. ч. с выражениями частотности

4-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 4, с. 53. a) Составь выражения частотности. b) Скажи, как часто ты делаешь дела с картинок. c) Сравни с одноклассником.
steps: a) once a day, once a month, once a year, twice a day, twice a week, three times a week, four times a month.
b) I tidy my room twice a week. I do the washing up four times a week. I go food shopping once a week. I lay the table every day.
c) I tidy my room twice a week, but Masha tidies her room once a week. I do the washing up four times a week, but Masha never does it.
4-s53.answer: once / twice / three times + a day / week / month / year; сравнение с but

5-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 5, с. 53. Напиши вопросы о Йене с How often…?
steps: How often does Ian do the washing up? How often does Ian go food shopping? How often does Ian lay the table? How often does Ian walk the dog? How often does Ian tidy his room?

6-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 6, с. 53. a) Напиши 6 предложений о том, как часто ты что-то делаешь. b) Расскажи одноклассникам.
steps: I tidy my room three times a week. I do the washing up every day. I go swimming twice a week. I watch TV every evening. I go food shopping once a week. I visit my grandma once a month.

7-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 7, с. 53. Прослушай, что делает Найри, и когда.
steps: Skate to school — from Monday to Friday. Clean the floor — from Monday to Friday. Play the guitar — at the weekend. Look after her sister — on Saturdays. Go to the cinema — once a month.
7-s53.answer: Занятия Найри и время: from Monday to Friday, at the weekend, on Saturdays, once a month

8-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 8, с. 53. Напиши историю о Tidy Ted (Аккуратном Теде).
steps: Tidy Ted tidies his room three times a week. He enjoys doing chores. He does the washing up every day. He lays the table every evening. He never leaves rubbish on the floor. He walks his dog twice a day. His mum is very happy.
8-s53.answer: Текст 6–7 предложений о Теде с частотностью

9-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 9, с. 53. Прослушай, как часто Найри делает дела.
steps: Once or twice a week — does the washing up. Always — hangs out with her friends after school. Sometimes — looks after her sister. Never — goes food shopping. Every day — skates to school.

10-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 10, с. 53. Прослушай ещё раз и исправь ошибки.
steps: sometimes → often; never → sometimes; every day → once or twice a week; three or four times a month → three times a week.
10-s53.answer: Исправления: often, sometimes, once or twice a week, three times a week

11-s53.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 20, упр. 11, с. 53. В парах задайте вопросы о Найри и ответьте.
steps: How often does Nyree tidy her room? — She often tidies her room. How often does Nyree look after her little sister? — Sometimes. How often does she do the washing up? — Once or twice a week. How often does she hang out with friends? — Every day.
11-s53.answer: How often does Nyree …? — наречие / выражение частоты

1-s54.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21 Saving the World, упр. 1, с. 54. Прослушай слова и найди их на картинках.
steps: cardboard boxes — 5; glass jars — 5; lorry — 6; metal cans — 3; paper — 4; plastic bottles — 1; wrappers — 2.
1-s54.answer: cardboard boxes 5, glass jars 5, lorry 6, metal cans 3, paper 4, plastic bottles 1

2-s54.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 2, с. 54. Прослушай историю: сколько в школе контейнеров для переработки?
steps: В школе пять контейнеров: жёлтый — пластик, синий — металл, зелёный — бумага, красный — обёртки, белый — стекло.
2-s54.answer: Five recycling boxes: yellow (plastic), blue (metal), green (paper), red (wrappers), white (glass)

3-s54.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 3, с. 54. Прочитай историю ещё раз и ответь на вопросы.
steps: They are holding rubbish. This bottle is made of plastic. It goes in the yellow box. The cans are made of metal — they go in the blue box. The lorry takes the rubbish to the recycling centre.
3-s54.answer: Дети держат мусор; бутылка из пластика → жёлтый ящик; банки из металла → синий; грузовик увозит на переработку

4-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 4, с. 55. Разыграй историю из упр. 2.
steps: — Hello, dear viewers. Today we're at school No 45. What do you recycle? — We recycle plastic, metal, paper and glass. — Where do the bottles go? — In the yellow box. — And the cans? — In the blue box. — Great job!
4-s55.answer: Ролевой диалог репортёра и учеников о переработке

5-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 5, с. 55. По картинкам упр. 2 скажи, что куда кладут.
steps: They put plastic bottles in the yellow box and metal cans in the blue box. They put old paper in the green box. Wrappers go in the red box and glass jars in the white box.
5-s55.answer: Пластик — жёлтый, металл — синий, бумага — зелёный, обёртки — красный, стекло — белый

6-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 6, с. 55. Прочитай и запомни слова.
steps: a bottle [bɒtl] — бутылка; a can [kæn] — жестяная банка; a jar [dʒɑː] — банка; a box [bɒks] — коробка; a wrapper [ˈræpə] — обёртка; cardboard — картон; glass — стекло; metal — металл; plastic — пластик.
6-s55.answer: bottle, can, jar, box, wrapper, cardboard, glass, metal, plastic

7-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 7, с. 55. В парах спросите: What are … made of?
steps: A: What are the wrappers made of? B: They are made of paper. A: What is the bottle made of? B: It's made of plastic. A: What are the cans made of? B: They're made of metal. A: What is the jar made of? B: It's made of glass.
7-s55.answer: What is / are … made of? — It's / They're made of + материал

8-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 8, с. 55. Соотнеси предметы с контейнерами: Where do … go?
steps: A: Where do the wrappers go? B: They go in the red box. A: Where does the bottle go? B: It goes in the yellow box. A: Where do the cans go? B: In the blue box. A: Where does the paper go? B: In the green box.
8-s55.answer: Where do / does … go? — in the red / yellow / blue / green box

9-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 9, с. 55. Прочитай о привычках девочки и назови, что она любит.
steps: Football. Chocolate. Ice skating. Jeans. Books.
9-s55.answer: football, chocolate, ice skating, jeans, books

10-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 10, с. 55. Что девочка на картинке делает сейчас?
steps: She is sitting on the bed. She is reading a book. She is also eating a chocolate bar. She is wearing jeans.
10-s55.answer: She's sitting on the bed, reading a book and eating chocolate

11-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 11, с. 55. a) Опиши свои привычки (Present Simple). b) Напиши 4 предложения о том, что делаешь сейчас (Present Progressive).
steps: a) I like all kinds of buns. I wear skirts and dresses. I play tennis. I read comics.
b) I'm calling my mum. I'm eating ice cream. I'm going to the cinema. I'm wearing a T-shirt.
11-s55.answer: a) Present Simple — привычки; b) Present Progressive — сейчас

12-s55.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 21, упр. 12, с. 55. Найди в классе предметы и скажи, из чего они сделаны.
steps: The vases are made of glass. The board is made of plastic. The desks are made of wood. The window frames are made of metal. The books are made of paper.
12-s55.answer: … is / are made of glass / plastic / wood / metal / paper

1-s56.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 22 Helping at Home, упр. 1, с. 56. Прослушай и прочитай текст: что такое B & B?
steps: A B & B (Bed and Breakfast) — домашняя мини-гостиница. Две из пяти спален отдают гостям, семья живёт в остальных. Мальчик помогает родителям: заправляет кровати и пылесосит комнаты гостей.
1-s56.answer: B & B — семейная мини-гостиница «ночлег и завтрак»; ребёнок помогает по хозяйству

2-s56.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 22, упр. 2, с. 56. Прочитай текст ещё раз и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) It is a Bed-and-Breakfast. 2) He helps his mother to make the beds and vacuum the guests' rooms. 3) There are five bedrooms. 4) Guests have breakfast in the dining room. 5) He likes talking to guests from different countries.
2-s56.answer: B&B; заправляет кровати и пылесосит; 5 спален; завтрак в столовой; любит общаться с гостями

3-s57.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 22, упр. 3, с. 57. Прослушай Адилу: как она помогает дома?
steps: Adila helps her mum. She sweeps the floor and shakes out the rugs. Then she collects wood for the fire and fetches water from the well. She also looks after the goats and helps to cook.
3-s57.answer: Подметает, вытряхивает коврики, собирает дрова, носит воду из колодца, смотрит за козами

4-s57.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 22, упр. 4, с. 57. Прослушай ещё раз и соотнеси действия с картинками.
steps: 1 — to sweep the floor; 2 — to shake out the rugs; 3 — to collect wood for the fire; 4 — to fetch water from the well; 5 — to look after the goats; 6 — to help cook.
4-s57.answer: sweep the floor, shake out the rugs, collect wood, fetch water, look after the goats, help cook

5-s57.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 22, упр. 5, с. 57. В группах ответьте на вопросы о семьях из текстов.
steps: 1) They have five bedrooms at home. 2) They help by talking to guests and answering their questions. 3) Adila lives in a village in Africa. 4) She fetches water from the well. 5) Both children help their parents every day.
5-s57.answer: Ответы по двум текстам (B&B и Адила)

6-s57.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 22, упр. 6, с. 57. Напиши, как ты помогаешь по дому.
steps: I do the washing up every day. I help my mum to cook dinner. I tidy my room twice a week. I walk the dog every morning. I sometimes go food shopping with my dad. I water the plants once a week.
6-s57.answer: 5–6 предложений о своей помощи по дому с частотностью

culture-s57.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 22, Culture, с. 57. Сравни домашние обязанности детей в Британии и России; составь список для России.
steps: In Russia children often help their parents with household chores: they tidy their rooms, wash the dishes, take out the rubbish, walk the dog, go shopping and look after younger brothers and sisters. In the country they also help in the garden. British children do similar chores and sometimes get pocket money for them.
culture-s57.answer: Список обязанностей российских детей + сравнение с британскими (похожие, но в Британии часто за карманные деньги)

1-s58.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 23 Reading, упр. 1, с. 58. Быстро прочитай интервью с членом Гринпис: в чём проблема?
steps: The number of freshwater seals in Lake Baikal is decreasing because the lake is polluted with chemicals — байкальских нерп становится меньше из-за загрязнения озера химикатами.
1-s58.answer: Сокращение числа байкальских нерп из-за загрязнения озера

2-s58.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 23, упр. 2, с. 58. Прочитай интервью ещё раз и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) Greenpeace is known all over the world. 2) One and a half million people support it in Russia. 3) Baikal is the deepest lake in the world. 4) Seals are dying because of chemicals from factories. 5) Greenpeace wants to stop the pollution.
2-s58.answer: Гринпис известен во всём мире; 1,5 млн сторонников; Байкал — самое глубокое озеро; нерпы гибнут от химикатов

3-s58.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 23, упр. 3, с. 58. В парах обсудите главные экологические проблемы своего региона.
steps: I live in Moscow. It's a big city with millions of people. The main problem is air pollution from cars and factories. There is also a lot of rubbish. We can help: recycle, use public transport and plant trees.
3-s58.answer: Проблемы: загрязнение воздуха, мусор; решения: переработка, транспорт, деревья

1-s59.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 24 Science, упр. 1, с. 59. Прослушай и повтори слова.
steps: dry [draɪ] — сухой; to throw away — выбрасывать; to tie together — связывать; to cut — резать; to fold — сгибать; to glue — клеить; fabric — ткань; recycle — перерабатывать.
1-s59.answer: dry, throw away, tie together, cut, fold, glue, fabric, recycle

2-s59.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 24, упр. 2, с. 59. Соотнеси слова с картинками.

3-s59.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 24, упр. 3, с. 59. Прочитай о креативных идеях переработки: какая лучшая?
steps: I think the most creative idea is to make a fabric chair from old clothes. It's useful and beautiful. The idea with a bird feeder from a plastic bottle is also good.
3-s59.answer: Своё мнение: I think the most creative idea is … because …

project-s59.condition: Unit 4, Lesson 24, Project, с. 59. Сделай проект из переработанного материала.
steps: Пример: I chose metal. I made a pencil holder from a tin can. I cleaned the can, dried it and glued coloured paper around it. Now it's on my desk. It's made of metal and paper.
project-s59.answer: Поделка из вторсырья + описание: материал, шаги, результат

vocabulary-s60.condition: Unit 4, Language Guide, Vocabulary, с. 60. Прочитай и запомни слова раздела.
steps: Work: tidy my room, do the washing up, go food shopping, lay the table, throw out the rubbish, vacuum, collect wood for the fire, fetch water.
Play: surf the internet, hang out with friends, play computer games.
Materials: plastic, metal, glass, paper, cardboard; bottle, can, jar, box, wrapper.
vocabulary-s60.answer: Словарь раздела 4: домашние дела, отдых, материалы

grammar-s61.condition: Unit 4, Language Guide, Grammar, с. 61. Повтори правила: Present Progressive, Present Simple vs Progressive, made of, выражения частотности.
steps: Present Progressive = am / is / are + V-ing — действие сейчас; вопрос What are you doing?
Present Simple — привычки и регулярные действия (every day, once a week).
It is made of + материал. How often…? — once / twice / three times a week.

1-s62.condition: Unit 4, Progress check, упр. 1, с. 62. Выбери правильную форму глагола в письме Эрику.
steps: 'm writing; 'm listening; come; play; go; doesn't like; 's sitting.
1-s62.answer: 'm writing, 'm listening, come, play, go, doesn't like, 's sitting

2-s62.condition: Unit 4, Progress check, упр. 2, с. 62. Какими делами заняты люди на картинках?
steps: He's tidying his room. They're doing the washing up. He's making his bed. He's vacuuming the carpet. They're throwing out the rubbish. She's walking the dog.
2-s62.answer: Предложения в Present Progressive по картинкам

3-s62.condition: Unit 4, Progress check, упр. 3, с. 62. Составь 4 правдивых предложения о частоте своих занятий.
steps: I surf the internet every day. I tidy my room once or twice a week. I walk my dog every afternoon. I go swimming twice a week.
3-s62.answer: 4 предложения с every day / once a week / twice a week

4-s62.condition: Unit 4, Progress check, упр. 4, с. 62. Составь предложения: It's / They're made of …
steps: It's made of cardboard. It's made of metal. They're made of plastic. They're made of paper. It's made of glass. It's made of wood.
4-s62.answer: cardboard, metal, plastic, paper, glass, wood

quiz-s63.condition: Unit 5 Comparing People, Animals or Things, с. 63. Викторина о людях: подбери прилагательные.
steps: a — tall; b — short; c — talkative; d — silent; e — friendly; f — unfriendly; g — hard-working; h — lazy; i — funny; j — serious.

1-s64.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25 Friends, упр. 1, с. 64. Прослушай и соотнеси слова с картинками.
steps: 1 — good at sport; 2 — talkative; 3 — funny; 4 — hard-working; 5 — friendly; 6 — tall.
1-s64.answer: good at sport, talkative, funny, hard-working, friendly, tall

2-s64.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 2, с. 64. Найди антонимы к словам из рамки.
steps: good — bad; funny — serious; hard-working — lazy; tall — short; talkative — silent; friendly — unfriendly.
2-s64.answer: good/bad, funny/serious, hard-working/lazy, tall/short, talkative/silent, friendly/unfriendly

3-s64.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 3, с. 64. Прочитай анкету и прослушай Нури: каковы её ответы?
steps: No, she isn't. They're the same. No, she isn't. They're the same. Yes, she is. No, she isn't. Yes, she is.
3-s64.answer: No / the same / No / the same / Yes / No / Yes

4-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 4, с. 65. Прослушай ещё раз и заполни пропуски.
steps: is; good; Tamsin, Nyree; both; Nyree, Tamsin; Tamsin, Nyree; is.
4-s65.answer: is, good, Tamsin/Nyree, both, Nyree/Tamsin, Tamsin/Nyree, is

5-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 5, с. 65. Расскажи о Найри и Тамсин, сравнивая их.
steps: Nyree is taller than Tamsin. Tamsin is more talkative than Nyree. Nyree is more hard-working than Tamsin. They're both funny. Tamsin is better at sport than Nyree. They're both friendly.
5-s65.answer: Сравнительная степень: taller, more talkative, more hard-working, better; both — одинаково

6-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 6, с. 65. Заполни анкету о себе и друге и сравни в парах.
steps: We're both talkative. I am more hard-working than my friend. But my friend is taller than me. We're both funny. My friend is better at sport than me. We are both friendly.
6-s65.answer: Сравнение себя и друга: X is …er / more … than Y; we're both …

7-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 7, с. 65. Составь рассказ об однокласснике и его друге.
steps: My classmate's name is Ben. He has got a friend, Nancy. Ben is taller than Nancy, but Nancy is more hard-working than Ben. They're both funny and friendly. Ben is better at sport, Nancy is more talkative.

8-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 8, с. 65. Прослушай и определи, о ком идёт речь: Бен или Пит?
steps: Ben; Pete; Ben; Pete; Pete; Ben; Pete; Ben.
8-s65.answer: Ben, Pete, Ben, Pete, Pete, Ben, Pete, Ben

9-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 9, с. 65. Составь предложения о Бене и Пите.
steps: Pete's drawing is better than Ben's. Pete's chair is more comfortable than Ben's. Ben is funnier than Pete. Pete is more hard-working than Ben. Ben is taller than Pete. Pete is more serious than Ben.
9-s65.answer: Сравнения с than: better, more comfortable, funnier, more hard-working, taller

10-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 10, с. 65. Сравни себя с членом семьи (7–8 предложений).
steps: My sister's name is Lena. She is older than me, but I'm taller than her. We are both hard-working and funny. She is more talkative than me. I am better at sport. She is more serious. We're both friendly. I think she is a better student than me.

11-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 11, с. 65. Напиши сравнительную степень прилагательных.
steps: long — longer; friendly — friendlier / more friendly; young — younger; small — smaller; big — bigger; short — shorter; happy — happier; good — better; bad — worse; talkative — more talkative; beautiful — more beautiful.
11-s65.answer: -er для коротких (longer, bigger, happier), more для длинных (more talkative), исключения better / worse

12-s65.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 25, упр. 12, с. 65. Сравни двух любимых певцов / актёров / спортсменов.
steps: Пример: Messi is better at dribbling than Ronaldo. Ronaldo is taller and stronger than Messi. They're both famous. Messi is more modest, Ronaldo is more talkative. I think Messi is the better player.

1-s66.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26 My Family, упр. 1, с. 66. Потренируй произношение прилагательных в превосходной степени.

steps: На картинке: granny Sally, cousin Gina, uncle Tony, the present from uncle Tony, sister Tina, dad, mum, the dog.

5-s67.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26, упр. 5, с. 67. Образуй превосходную степень прилагательных из рамки.
steps: the messiest; the best; the youngest; the fittest; the friendliest; the biggest; the most beautiful; the smallest; the most generous; the oldest.
5-s67.answer: the messiest, the best, the youngest, the fittest, the friendliest, the biggest, the most beautiful, the smallest

6-s67.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26, упр. 6, с. 67. По картинке с. 66 составь предложения о семье Уэйна в превосходной степени.
steps: My granny is the oldest. My cousin Gina is the youngest and the most beautiful. Uncle Tony is the most generous. My sister Tina is the messiest. My dad is the fittest. My mum is the friendliest.

steps: A — cousin Joe; B — uncle Fred; C — brother Mike; D — mum; E — great-grandma; F — cousin Jen; G — sister Sue.

8-s67.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26, упр. 8, с. 67. Расскажи о семье Уэйна по таблице упр. 4.
steps: Wayne has got a big family. His cousin Gina is the youngest. His uncle Tony is the most generous. His granny Sally is the oldest. His sister Tina is the messiest. His dad is the fittest and his mum is the friendliest.

9-s67.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26, упр. 9, с. 67. a) Напиши 5 вопросов Who is the … in your family? b) Задай их однокласснику.
steps: Who is the youngest person in your family? Who is the fittest? Who is the friendliest? Who is the most talkative? Who is the most hard-working?
Ответы: My brother is the youngest. My dad is the fittest. My mum is the friendliest…
9-s67.answer: 5 вопросов Who is the …est / the most … in your family? и ответы партнёра

10-s67.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26, упр. 10, с. 67. Напиши о семье одноклассника.
steps: My Friend's Family. Lena has got a small family. Her father Oleg is the smartest person in her family. Her mother Anna is the friendliest. Her brother Max is the youngest and the most talkative. Lena is the most hard-working.

11-s67.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26, упр. 11, с. 67. Заполни пропуски превосходной степенью.
steps: the tallest; the most hard-working; the best; the friendliest; the most talkative; the longest.
11-s67.answer: the tallest, the most hard-working, the best, the friendliest, the most talkative, the longest

12-s67.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 26, упр. 12, с. 67. Напиши правдивые предложения о своей семье.
steps: My Family. I have got a small family. My father Oleg is the most generous. My mother Anna is the friendliest. My brother is the youngest and the funniest. My granny is the oldest and the best cook. I am the most talkative.
12-s67.answer: 5–6 предложений о своей семье в превосходной степени

2-s68.answer: B C F J K N Q T

steps: Ответы совпадают с ключом: B, C, F, J, K, N, Q, T.
3-s68.answer: B C F J K N Q T

4-s69.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 27, упр. 4, с. 69. Дополни предложения о животных сравнительной и превосходной степенью.
steps: faster; the fastest; more dangerous; the most dangerous; more intelligent; the most intelligent; stronger; the strongest; slower; the slowest.
4-s69.answer: faster / the fastest, more dangerous / the most dangerous, more intelligent / the most intelligent, stronger / the strongest

5-s69.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 27, упр. 5, с. 69. Составь 3 верных и 3 неверных утверждения о животных; одноклассник проверяет.
steps: A dog is smaller than an elephant — true. A lion is more dangerous than a cat — true. A flamingo is taller than a rooster — true. A snail is faster than a cheetah — false. An ant is bigger than a bear — false. A tortoise is the fastest animal — false.

6-s69.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 27, упр. 6, с. 69. Прослушай разговор Энни и Билли и разыграй его.
steps: Энни спрашивает, какое животное самое быстрое; Билли считает, что гепард. Энни: а какое самое опасное? Билли: комар — он переносит болезни. Читаем по ролям.

7-s69.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 27, упр. 7, с. 69. В парах закончите диалог словами из рамки.

9-s69.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 27, упр. 9, с. 69. Обменяйтесь викторинами и ответьте.

1-s70.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 28 City or Country?, упр. 1, с. 70. Прочитай и прослушай историю Стива: почему ему не нравится жить в деревне?
steps: Steve doesn't like living in the country because he thinks it's boring. It's more difficult to go shopping because there are no big shops. His friends live far away and there is no cinema.
1-s70.answer: Скучно, магазины далеко, друзья далеко, нет кинотеатра

2-s70.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 28, упр. 2, с. 70. Найди в истории Стива три плюса и три минуса деревни.
steps: (+) It's quieter than in the city; more beautiful than in the city; cleaner than in the city.
(−) It's more boring; more difficult to go shopping; friends live farther away.
2-s70.answer: Плюсы: тише, красивее, чище; минусы: скучнее, сложнее с покупками, друзья далеко

3-s70.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 28, упр. 3, с. 70. Прослушай Хелен из деревни Чарфилд: где ей лучше?
steps: Helen thinks it's better to live in the country because all her friends live close to her house and they hang out in the fields. It's safer and quieter than in the city.
3-s70.answer: Хелен предпочитает деревню: друзья рядом, безопаснее и тише
